initial:home.title: Pocetna, normalan tekst
initial:home.review: Ordinary text: both starting actions and the next appointment are readable. Internal gallery omits root navigation by design.

initial:home-empty.title: Prvi ulazak, normalan tekst
initial:home-empty.review: Inert first-entry artwork and starting actions fit at ordinary text size; no live-account claim.

initial:map.title: Sveza mapa i lista, stvarni podaci samo citanje
initial:map.review: Read-only: seven real results, four without map points; remaining public points span multiple cities. Credits and selected root tab visible.

initial:detail.title: Detalj stvarnog zadatka, normalan tekst
initial:detail.review: Read-only: title, price wording, place/time/people and 56 dp publisher fallback readable; relationship footer visible. No application opened.

initial:detail-lower.title: Detalj, mesto i pitanja
initial:detail-lower.review: Read-only scroll: approximate public area, map attribution, privacy wording and question entry reachable; footer remains visible.

initial:map-pin.title: Izabrani pin i pregled zadatka
initial:map-pin.review: Refinement identified: selected Belgrade task remains at a broad regional camera. Preview facts and close action are readable; seven-result count unchanged.

initial:search.title: Bela pretraga, normalan tekst
initial:search.review: White panel has stable header, readable sections and a visible real-result action at ordinary text size.

initial:search-people.title: Tri osobe, stvarni broj rezultata
initial:search-people.review: Three-person local filter previews two real results; applying showed two results and an active filter badge. No business mutation.

initial:offer.title: Ponuda, normalan tekst, inertni primer
initial:offer.review: Inert filled offer: terms and message reachable. Refinement identified: 32 sp amount too strong at ordinary size; correction uses 28 sp.

initial:offer-review.title: Pregled ponude, bez slanja
initial:offer-review.review: Inert review includes all terms and submitted message, with send/edit controls. No send performed. XML dump timed out; screenshot only.

initial:offer-unknown.title: Neizvestan ishod, stvarne komande inertne
initial:offer-unknown.review: Inert uncertain outcome exposes saved terms/message and the existing outcome-check control. No readback command invoked.

initial:offer-confirmed.title: Potvrdjena prijava, lokalni primer bez slanja
initial:offer-confirmed.review: Inert confirmed outcome starts at the outcome and shows one action. Fixture is not proof of a real submission.

initial:offer-confirmed-terms.title: Poslati uslovi i poruka, lokalni primer
initial:offer-confirmed-terms.review: Inert confirmed receipt scroll exposes full terms and exact trimmed message; primary remains accessible.

initial:offer-large-people.title: Inert offer: two-digit people, enlarged-text resilience only
initial:offer-large-people.review: At 320 dp/font scale 2, typed 10 is fully visible between stepper buttons; existing three-place refusal and disabled review visible. Restored density 420 and font scale 1.0. Not the ordinary design baseline.
initial:offer-large-people.note: Local input changed from 2 to 10 with keyboard; no command. Large-text check only, not ordinary design baseline.

refined:offer.title: Ponuda: umerenija cena, normalan tekst
refined:offer.review: Ordinary text: 28 sp input amount is visibly calmer than the initial 32 sp capture. Context, capacity and terms remain readable; review action reachable. Inert fixture, no send.
refined:offer.note: Inert local filled offer. No send.

refined:offer-review.title: Pregled pre slanja: umerenija cena
refined:offer-review.review: Ordinary text: 28 sp receipt amount, all terms and complete message fit the native sheet. Both send and edit controls visible. Inert review only; fresh XML available.

refined:map-pin.title: Izabrani javni pin: prikaz kraja
refined:map-pin.review: Read-only explicit pin selection now frames the public Belgrade neighborhood instead of the regional overview. Green logo pin is visible above the complete task card; credits and selected root navigation remain visible. No exact private address used.
refined:map-pin.note: Tapped existing public offer pin from initial half-list. Read-only; no user-area filter command.

refined:map-cleared.title: Mapa posle zatvaranja pregleda
refined:map-cleared.review: Closing the card retains neighborhood zoom and public pin position. The list still says seven tasks/four without points, and search remains Svi zadaci: selection did not apply an area filter.
refined:map-cleared.note: Closed selected card; read-only. Inspect count and retained neighborhood camera.
